name: Narul
slug: Narul, known as the Stranger, is a mysterious elder god and former god of death who communicates sparingly and remains reserved with the party.
description: Narul, also known as the Stranger, is an elder god and former god of death. He is a mysterious divine figure who communicates sparingly and tends to remain reserved in matters involving the party.

log.summary: Narul, also known as the Stranger, silently acknowledges the party during the council with a nod, a gesture toward his forehead, and a slight bow before departing. He provides no additional information or explanation during the council.
notes: Silently gives the party a nod, forehead gesture, and slight bow before departing.
Provides no additional information during the council.
